module.purpose: Manages a collection of QueryObserver instances, reconciles them with query options, combines their results, and notifies subscribers of batched changes for multiple queries observed together.
module.summary: This file implements the QueriesObserver class that observes multiple queries as a single subscribable unit. It maintains a list of QueryObserver instances matched to given query options, updates the combined result when individual observers emit, and supports an optional user-provided combine function with memoization. It extends Subscribable and uses notifyManager to batch listener notifications. Helper functions provide array difference and immutable index replacement. The class also provides optimistic result computation and property tracking across observers for fine-grained reactivity.
module.businessContext: Part of React Query core enabling useQueries to track multiple queries together. Failure breaks multi-query observation, combined results, and optimistic updates.

units.name: constructor
units.source:
constructor(
    client: QueryClient,
    queries: Array<QueryObserverOptions<any, any, any, any, any>>,
    options?: QueriesObserverOptions<TCombinedResult>,
  ) {
    super()

    this.#client = client
    this.#options = options
    this.#queries = []
    this.#observers = []
    this.#result = []

    this.setQueries(queries)
  }
